title: KyuubiSoft Chatpresets
description: A simple mod to add button somewhere on the screen that writes text in the chat.
body:
# KyuubiSoft ChatPresets
![KyuubiSoft ChatPresets Banner](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-green?style=for-the-badge) ![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-API-blue?style=for-the-badge) ![Client Side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Client-Side-orange?style=for-the-badge)
## Overview **KyuubiSoft ChatPresets** is a client-side Fabric mod that revolutionizes your Minecraft chat experience with customizable quick-access buttons. Say goodbye to typing the same messages repeatedly! ## Features ### Core Features - **Quick Chat Buttons** - Access your favorite messages with a single click - **Minecraft Item Icons** - Use any Minecraft item as your button icon - **Drag & Drop** - Position your button bar anywhere on screen - **Server-Specific Configs** - Different presets for different servers - **RGB Color Picker** - Customize text and background colors ### Customization Options - **Horizontal/Vertical Layout** - Arrange buttons your way - **Adjustable Button Size** - From 8x8 to 64x64 pixels - **Background Toggle** - Show or hide button backgrounds - **Chat-Only Mode** - Buttons appear only when chat is open - **Per-Server Settings** - Automatic preset switching ## Getting Started 1. **Open Configuration** - Press `P` (default) or click the mod in Mod Menu - Access settings from the main menu or in-game 2. **Create Your First Preset** - Click "+ Add New Preset" - Enter a name and your chat message - Choose an icon from 100+ Minecraft items - Pick your colors with the RGB picker 3. **Use Your Presets** - Click any button to open chat with your message - Drag the button bar to reposition - Toggle visibility as needed ## Configuration
General Settings - **Orientation**: Horizontal or Vertical layout - **Position**: X/Y coordinates or drag to move - **Button Size**: 8-64 pixels - **Visibility**: Toggle on/off - **Background**: Show/hide button backgrounds - **Drag Mode**: Enable/disable repositioning
Advanced Options - **Only Show if Chat Visible**: Buttons appear only with chat open - **Server-Specific Configs**: Separate settings per server - **Text Length**: Up to 1000 characters per preset
## Commands All commands start with `/chatpresets`: ``` /chatpresets list - Show all presets /chatpresets add - Create new preset /chatpresets remove - Delete preset /chatpresets use - Copy preset text to chat /chatpresets reload - Reload configuration ``` ## Technical Details - **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.1 - **Mod Loader**: Fabric - **Dependencies**: Fabric API - **Client-Side Only**: No server installation needed - **Performance**: Minimal impact, efficient rendering ## Compatibility - ✅ Works with most client-side mods - ✅ Compatible with Mod Menu - ✅ No conflicts with chat mods - ✅ Multiplayer friendly ## License This mod is licensed under the MIT License. Feel free to use it in modpacks! ---
**Made with ❤️ by KyuubiSoft**
